groups.reason: Both are level-0 pages built on the same interaction: pinch into a photo until it breaks into squares, then halve or double the resolution and watch it go blocky or sharp. pixels-and-pictures is better scoped for Computing because it frames the pixel as stored numbers, with shade counts and a fourfold jump in data for each doubling. The distinctive part of screens-and-pixels, three RGB lights blended by the eye, is mostly covered by vision-color's light mixing. It can survive as one scene inside pixels-and-pictures.
